title: postapiauthregisterwithvalidcolombiandocumentdataandconsent
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/register successfully creates an account when provided with valid Colombian document data, user consent, and a strong password, returning HTTP 201.

title: postapiauthloginwithvalidcredentials
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials returns HTTP 200 and sets an HttpOnly session cookie for secure authentication.

title: postapiauthmfaverifywithvalidtotp
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/mfa/verify with a valid TOTP code returns HTTP 200 and upgrades the session to fully authenticated status.

title: postapiauthregisterwithinvaliddocumentormissingconsent
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/register with invalid document type or missing user consent returns HTTP 400 with appropriate validation error messages.

title: postapiauthloginwithinvalidpasswordmultipletimes
description: Verify that multiple failed login attempts via POST /api/auth/login with invalid passwords trigger account lockout or brute-force protection, returning HTTP 423 or 429.

title: postapiauthrecoveryrequestwithunregisteredemail
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/recovery/request with an unregistered email or identifier returns HTTP 404 or 400 with a generic recovery failure message.

title: postapiauthrecoveryconfirmwithexpiredotp
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/recovery/confirm with an expired OTP returns HTTP 400 with an expired token error.

title: postemergencyadmissionswithpatientdataoranonymousintake
description: Verify that POST /api/emergency/admissions accepts patient data or anonymous intake and returns HTTP 201 with an emergency admission record.

title: postemergencytriagewithvitalsignsandglasgowscore
description: Verify that POST /api/emergency/triage with valid vital signs and Glasgow score returns HTTP 200 with an assigned triage level.

title: getemergencyqueuewithnursesession
description: Verify that GET /api/emergency/queue with a nurse session returns HTTP 200 with a prioritized queue filtered by site.
